name: Porta Tiburtina
text: Porta Tiburtina or Porta San Lorenzo is a gate in the Aurelian Walls of Rome, Italy, through which the Via Tiburtina exits the city.

depictions.name: Porta Tiburtina
depictions.text: Porta Tiburtina is one of the eastern gates of the Aurelian Walls of Rome in the Campagna District, so named for the Via Tiburtina that ran through it. It is adorned with bull skulls, a relic of its origins as an ornamental arch.
